exact: membrane repolarization involved in regulation of AV node cardiac muscle cell action potential
membrane repolarization involved in regulation of atrioventricular node cardiac muscle cell action potential

definition: The process in which ions are transported across a membrane such that the AV node cardiac muscle cell membrane potential changes in the direction from the positive membrane potential at the peak of the action potential towards the negative resting potential.
label: membrane repolarization during AV node cell action potential
